name: Christmas Snow
description: Add christmas snow to your site.
project_description:
This is a very small module that adds a Christmas Snow effect to your site. 

 I thank Scott Schiller for the javascript code . 

 You are welcome to hack the module if you want the lights and submit a patch :-) 

 Get into the Christmas spirit!

 Rohit-rajput-sahab is the new owner of this module.

 Drupal 4,5,6,7,8,9 
 We have stopped supporting "Christmas snow" version 4,5,6,7,8,9.

 Drupal 10, 11 and 12 
 We are Actively maintained in "Christmas snow" version 10, 11 and 12.

 Install it like any other module 

 composer require drupal/christmas_snow 

 Back to top
